summary_en: AXIS will acquire up to 150,000 shares (3.49% of shares outstanding) for up to ¥239.7 million via ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of ¥1,598 on November 20, 2026.
title_en: Notice on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Treasury Stock Purchase via Off-Market Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On November 19, 2026, AXIS's Board of Directors approved the acquisition of treasury stock via off-market trading (ToSTNeT-3) on November 20, 2026. The company will purchase up to 150,000 shares at the closing price of ¥1,598 per share for a total outlay not exceeding ¥239.7 million. This represents 3.49% of outstanding shares (calculated from the reference base of 4,296,547 shares excluding treasury stock as of November 19). The purchase will be executed in a single order during the morning session of ToSTNeT-3 trading, with results announced after the 8:45 a.m. trading window closes. The company cited the need for flexible capital allocation responsive to changes in the operating environment as the rationale for this acquisition.
